answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we deploy recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments alongside a verifiable delay function that acts as a sequential cryptographic barrier. By requiring staking collateral subject to automatic slashing penalties, we bound the network's Nash equilibrium to guarantee negative expected attack utility. Our model proves that any adversarial ember attempting to disrupt this vast ocean of nodes is neutralized, much like a pure lotus blooming unperturbed by turbulent waters.
